description: Mastermind — crack the secret 4-color code in 10 tries with black/white peg feedback.

faqs.a: A black peg means one of your colors is exactly right (right color, right spot). A white peg means a color is right but in the wrong spot. Pegs are not lined up with specific holes — count them, don't map them.
faqs.q: What do the black and white pegs mean?

faqs.a: Yes, colors can repeat in the secret code — don't assume four different colors.
faqs.q: Can a color appear more than once?

faqs.a: Start with four different colors to maximize information, then use the peg counts to eliminate possibilities. Watch out for duplicate-color feedback.

howto: Black peg = right color in the right spot.
White peg = right color, wrong spot.
Crack the code within 10 attempts to win.
title: Mastermind
